why: Uniform design 2: design 1 (recalibrated) with a real winner-take-all bump. The burst drive rises slowly (R tau 3, drive +5), so during each burst's rise the nodes whose integrated light is highest cross first. Their self- and neighbour-excitation (self 3, neighbours 2) holds a bump of ~3 nodes, and G (4 x sum, bias -8, tau 1, -8 to all) switches on once ~2-3 nodes are active and silences the rest. The bump's beats pull the cell toward the brightest side. Expected: a clear pull toward brighter light in the mid field; little in the far field, where the light across the body is far below the sensors' noise.
